description: 太陽光パネル設置公共施設一覧 [electricity and power and evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 豊岡市. 太陽光パネルが設置されている公共施設一覧になります. Coverage: 豊岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 豊岡市. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設, 再生可能エネルギー, 太陽光, 太陽光パネル. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-10-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
